'''Taigo''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] Moff who was diagnosed with the [[Quannot's Syndrome]]. To replace his infected organs, Taigo sought to obtain new organs from the black market.<ref name="Organ">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Organ Transplant}}</ref>
